scope: General positive-discount Cass constructed existence, capital and consumption monotonicity, convergence, eventual positive investment, finite candidate welfare, all-competitor asymptotic welfare dominance, and finite-welfare optimality/uniqueness from primitive Inada and C2 assumptions. Explicit square-root specialization. Certified obstruction to the regular convergent Euler characterization under Koopmans appendix scalar assumptions. Original undiscounted Ramsey and zero/negative-discount extensions are outside scope.
